notes:
New: a built-in HELP system — press F1 anywhere (Settings included) and VP Studio opens help on
the screen you're standing on, with a topic tree, instant offline search, and real screenshots.
The manual and the help window share the same figures.

Keyboard shortcuts throughout, remappable in Settings ▸ Shortcuts: single-letter tool keys on
the Studio page (V select, T text, L line, I image, B barcode, X box, P purge setup), F5–F8 to
jump between pages, zoom and fit keys, and Space on the Print page to start the run behind an
are-you-sure (Space again confirms, Esc cancels). Pick your startup page (Home, Studio, Data or
Print) in Settings — start on Print with "open the last job" and reprinting yesterday's job is
launch, Space, Space.

The installer now shows this PC's licensing status in plain words (edition, expiry, Machine ID),
explains the editions, and can take a license key during installation — or skip it and run in
mock mode until a key arrives. When going back to an older version, the installer now says so
("Go back to …") instead of calling it an update.

Licensing is hardened against clock tampering: keys carry their issue date, and the suite tracks
the latest date the machine has reached — setting the system clock back no longer extends a
timed license, and a date from before the key existed is flagged until fixed. (Existing keys
keep working.)
